verses.1: A prayer for David when he was in the land of Judah.
verses.2: God, you are my Lord. You have nourished me with Your love. My soul is like a flower in the land of suffering; it is weak and without hope.
verses.3: Also, in the Holy Day, you shall see your glory and your beauty.
verses.4: For your kindness is better than life; may my lips praise you.
verses.5: May I bless you in my life, in your name. I will place my hands upon you.
verses.6: Just as milk and honey nourish the soul, so too will those who sing joyfully fill our hearts with happiness.
verses.7: If you remember my instructions, then you will be able to fulfill them.
verses.8: For you have been my help, and with the light of your wings, I can shine.
verses.9: My soul has been united with yours; may your right hand bless me always.
verses.10: And those who seek to do evil will be punished. Their souls will come to ruin in the depths of the earth.
verses.11: It will be led away by the power of evil spirits.
verses.12: And the king will rejoice in God; all those who praise Him will sing praises to Him, because the lips of those who speak lies will be silenced.
